# ColorCollect

> ColorCollect (colorcollectapp.com) is a free color scavenger hunt photo game for Android: pick a color, photograph real-world things that match it, and the shots snap into one shareable photo montage — solo, or with friends via a 6-letter room code and no accounts. It is not the unrelated "Color Collect" color-picker app.

This site also gives away free printable color scavenger hunt sheets and hunt ideas for kids, classrooms, parties, families and long-distance friends and couples.

## Printable hunts and guides

- [Color scavenger hunt guide](https://colorcollectapp.com/color-scavenger-hunt/): rules, variations and color lists for every age
- [Free printable color scavenger hunt](https://colorcollectapp.com/color-scavenger-hunt-printable/): four print-ready sheets (kids, adults and parties, classroom rainbow, road trip)
- [Color scavenger hunt generator](https://colorcollectapp.com/color-scavenger-hunt-generator/): builds a custom printable list by age and number of colors
- [Fall scavenger hunt](https://colorcollectapp.com/fall-scavenger-hunt/): A free printable fall scavenger hunt built around autumn colors — two sheets for a nature walk with kids or adults, plus 20 things to find.
- [Thanksgiving scavenger hunt](https://colorcollectapp.com/thanksgiving-scavenger-hunt/): A free printable Thanksgiving scavenger hunt for kids and family — an indoor color hunt to run while dinner cooks, plus 20 things to find.
- [Christmas scavenger hunt](https://colorcollectapp.com/christmas-scavenger-hunt/): A free printable Christmas scavenger hunt for kids and family — a color hunt for indoor decorations and a Christmas lights walk.
- [Winter scavenger hunt](https://colorcollectapp.com/winter-scavenger-hunt/): A free printable winter scavenger hunt for kids and classrooms — no holiday theme, an outdoor walk and an indoor version, 20 things to find.

## Playing together

- [Play with friends](https://colorcollectapp.com/play-with-friends/): group hunts with a live shared grid and voting
- [Photo scavenger hunt app](https://colorcollectapp.com/photo-scavenger-hunt-app/): how the app compares to generic photo-hunt apps
- [Long-distance friends games](https://colorcollectapp.com/long-distance-friends-games/)
- [Long-distance relationship activities](https://colorcollectapp.com/long-distance-relationship-activities/): 18 color-based date ideas for couples
- [Photo map](https://colorcollectapp.com/photo-map/): every find pinned on a map (opt-in, per shot)

## Color of the day

- [Color of the day](https://colorcollectapp.com/color-of-the-day/): the one color every player hunts today, changing at midnight UTC
- [Color of the day widget](https://colorcollectapp.com/color-of-the-day-widget/): free embed for blogs and classroom pages

## Get the app

- [Google Play](https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=dev.colorcollect.color_collect&utm_source=colorcollect-site&utm_medium=referral&utm_campaign=site&utm_content=llms)
- Free to play, no ads, optional in-app purchases.
